thread:
kevin: Quick heads-up — we're cutting the RC branch in ~2h. Need a coordinated docsite deploy + SDK docs regen before cutoff. Who can own the docsite deploy? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: I can run the docsite deploy but need the final changelog/version bump merged first. Which version are we landing?

anita: Bump target is v1.4.2 (changelog PR #342 has the notes). I pushed a tiny edit ~10m ago, should be ready for review.

kevin: Great. @release-coordinator can you confirm changelog PR is green? Also we need the SDK docs regen for the new CLI flag (breaking change doc).

release-coordinator: CI passed on #342, approvals in place. I've added the version bump on the release branch (cherry-picked commit).

maria: OK, I'll wait for the merge and then: 1) run SDK docs regen 2) deploy docs to staging 3) smoke test and then promote. Plan to run in that order.

kevin: Perfect. For the SDK regen, use this command (from monorepo root):
```
# regen SDK docs for the JS/TS SDK and publish artifacts to S3 staging
yarn workspace @redwood/docs run regen-sdk --target js,ts --version 1.4.2
```

maria: Thanks — will run that after merge. Heads-up: caching on the CDN sometimes serves old assets; I'll purge edge cache after deploy with the internal endpoint:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-cache.redwood/purge" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CACHE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"paths":["/docs/*","/sdk/*"]}'
```

anita: If anyone needs to pick up a last-minute doc change, please open a quick PR against the release branch and ping me. I can cherry-pick.

docs-bot: deploy queued -> staging-url: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/rc-1.4.2 :rocket: (job 7812)

maria: Staging deploy started, running regen now. I'll post when smoke tests finish. @kevin can you verify console screenshots after deploy?

kevin: Yep — will check UI screenshots / console routes. If anything looks off we can gate the release behind the console feature flag and roll forward later.

maria: Smoke tests passed, staging looks good, SDK docs regen succeeded and artifacts uploaded. Purging cache now.

docs-bot: cache purge success (paths: /docs/*, /sdk/*), CDN TTL cleared.

release-coordinator: All set on my end. RC cut can proceed in ~5m. Thanks all for the fast turnaround. :tada:

kevin: Awesome — tagging the RC cut step in the release checklist and kicking the branch cut. I'll follow up if anything pops up.

maria: Quick note for post-release: we should add a short blurb in the release notes about the new SDK flag and link to the updated SDK docs. I'll draft it after the cut.

anita: Sounds good. Thanks everyone!
